name: What is the typical process for conducting a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for conducting a Website Audit for Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial content and technical crawl, evaluating how AI systems might currently interpret your site. This is followed by a deep dive into content clarity, factual accuracy, E-E-A-T signals (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness), and structured data implementation. We analyze key pages for summarization potential and identify content gaps or areas for improvement. Recommendations often include content rewriting, schema markup enhancements, and internal linking strategies. The final step involves a detailed report with actionable insights and a roadmap for implementation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves crawling your site, analyzing content for AI interpretation, assessing E-E-A-T, identifying improvements, and providing an actionable report.
